research.topic: Single‑tasking (focusing on one activity at a time)
research.hook: Can you ace a chapter in just 45 minutes by doing ONE thing at a time? Here’s how toppers do it.
research.tip: The 45‑Minute Focus Sprint: pick one sub‑task, set a 45‑min timer, eliminate distractions, work only on that task, then take a 5‑min micro‑break before repeating.
